note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as published on PlayStation and tracked by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Guides are written for this entry, in our own words, and cite their sources.

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks by itself — it is always the last trophy you earn. Follow the roadmap in order (story, then the 100% checklist, then cleanup) and use the checklist here to see what is still left.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Complete the opening mission, Gone Fishing. This is the first mission of the game, so it unlocks naturally within minutes of starting; there is nothing to prepare or find.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. Keep playing the main story missions and this pops when the first chapter ends. Like every story trophy it unlocks automatically on completion.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Story progress only — finish the chapter's missions and it unlocks at the chapter's end.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Same as the other chapter trophies: play the story through and it pops when Chapter 3 ends.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. Finish the fourth chapter's missions and this unlocks at its end.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. This is the last story mission, in Chapter 5; it unlocks as the story ends and the credits roll. After it, free-roam continues and everything needed for 100% completion is still reachable, according to PowerPyx.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Finish the mission and the trophy unlocks. PowerPyx notes there is no mission replay in GTA 6, so complete story missions when they appear — but this one pops on completion, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Finish the heist mission and the trophy pops; it is a story trophy, so it unlocks automatically on completion.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Finish the mission and the trophy unlocks automatically.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Finish the mission and the trophy unlocks automatically.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. Finish the mission at Vice City International Airport and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Finish the mission and the trophy unlocks automatically.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Attain 100% Completion. PowerPyx calls this the hardest trophy: after the story, the checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, and it is lenient — roughly 60% of true completion. Only 70 of 80 Challenges are needed, and you only have to scan 200 of 277 vehicles and study 100 of 255 animals. Work through it after the story; most of it comes from the other trophies.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are jumps, airtime and near-miss driving tricks; they add up across the whole game, so take jumps and drive fast whenever you get the chance, and check your count on the stats screen.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. The game tracks 9 activity types; work through the activities as you meet them — racing, the shooting range, fishing, the arcade and the rest — and the trophy pops once you have tried all nine.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Practise each range challenge until you beat its gold score. PowerPyx rates the gold medals as not too difficult, and the ranges are easier with better weapons, so this is a good post-story job.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. There are 14 drone race locations; win one race at each. PowerPyx counts 42 races across the 14 locations, so you only need a win at each spot, not every race.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Enter race events around Leonida and win 20 distinct ones — winning the same race twice does not count twice, so keep entering new races.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal and take him on in a fishing contest, then out-fish him. Learn the fishing minigame first — steady timing beats button-mashing.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Play any arcade cabinet until you finish a full game. Pick the simplest cabinet you find and see it through to the end.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy is one of five side characters with their own mission strand; play his missions as they appear and finish the last one. The side strands unlock as the story progresses.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton is one of five side characters with their own mission strand; play his missions as they appear and finish the last one.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy is one of five side characters with their own mission strand; play his missions as they appear and finish the last one.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Stranger missions appear as markers around the map; finish eight full strands. PowerPyx puts this in the final cleanup step, after the story and the 100% checklist.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy is one of five side characters with their own mission strand; play his missions as they appear and finish the last one.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone is one of five side characters with their own mission strand; play his missions as they appear and finish the last one.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in total. PowerPyx and GTABase flag this as the only potentially missable trophy: the first meditation is offered at Jason's house during Chapter 1 and becomes unavailable after that chapter, so meditate there as soon as the game offers it. Then find the other spots as you explore; GTA Zone lists 18 spots across 10 locations.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Follow Bret's missions until he asks you to hunt a unique animal, then track it down and take it. PowerPyx lists Bret's quests among the tasks the 100% checklist needs in full.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida; collect full sets, three sets in total. Use a card-location map from a guide site once the locations are mapped — PowerPyx keeps a collectible guide alongside its trophy guide.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK It is the in-game photo app: take and share photos at 100 different spots around Leonida. Do it while exploring for The Goodtime State so the two trophies progress together.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are side objectives scattered through the game; finish any 50. You only need 70 of 80 for 100% completion, according to PowerPyx, so there is room to skip the hardest ones.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Build your wanted level to 4 stars while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the heat dies down. A quiet corner of the map and a fast car help.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Plan a route past three shops, rob each in turn with your partner, and keep your wanted level the whole way — do not let it clear or get busted between robberies.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive and scan new vehicles as you find them; the count tracks what you have discovered. PowerPyx notes the 100% checklist needs 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, so keep discovering as you go and this pops on the way.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a busy shootout with a group of enemies, trigger Combat Focus, and drop five before it ends. A crowded fight beats a quiet one.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. At Vice City International Airport, leave in a plane on your own schedule — take an aircraft and get airborne without following the normal departure.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Rhinos are the game's tanks, and this trophy is built around one. No guide had a confirmed method at launch, so check PowerPyx's trophy guide for the confirmed approach before chasing it rather than guessing.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Case the store, avoid cameras and guards, and get in and out without ever being spotted. A quiet approach beats speed — if anyone sees you, it does not count.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Bank vault robberies are the big scores; pull off five and get away clean each time. PowerPyx lists robberies among the tasks the 100% checklist needs in full.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Find an armored truck on the road, stop it, take the cash and lose the cops. Trucks run regular routes, so keep an eye on the roads while driving.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. The list tracks 52 areas; visit every region of the map and the trophy pops when the last one registers. Combine it with WAiNK It photos and vehicle discovery so one trip covers three trophies.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (named source)

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. There are 9 gangs; hit one illegal operation for each of them. Gang territory becomes clear as you explore Leonida and take on side content.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view. PowerPyx lists this trophy's exact unlock as not yet confirmed at launch, so take the description literally and check the guide for updates.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive through a vehicle showroom's front in style. PowerPyx lists this trophy's exact method as not yet confirmed at launch — check the guide for updates.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley and finish a game — follow through on your throws and play it out to the end.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The description is deliberately vague — it reads like a partner moment that draws a crowd. No guide had a confirmed method at launch, so check PowerPyx's guide for updates rather than guessing.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). The list tracks choices up to a count of 500, so this appears to count decisions made across the game. Play through the story and side content making choices as they come; it should unlock naturally over a full playthrough.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (named source)
PSNProfiles — GTA VI trophy list (named source)

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The description suggests succeeding on a second attempt at something you first failed. PowerPyx lists this trophy's exact unlock as not yet confirmed at launch — check the guide for updates.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? This is the game's strange-encounter trophy — an odd, unexplained event somewhere in Leonida. PowerPyx lists the exact unlock as not yet confirmed at launch, so check the guide for updates rather than chasing rumours.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. PowerPyx lists the exact method as not yet confirmed at launch — check the guide for updates.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; launder them through your contacts and the total adds up across the game until it hits $250,000. Keep laundering after every big score.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, weapons, food and anything else in shops until your total spending reaches $100,000 — it counts across every shop in the game, so it builds up naturally.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. There are 8 garage properties to buy around Leonida; save up and buy them all for vehicle storage.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Use the Scooter Bros app to register vehicles you find — each new registration counts, ten in total.
trophies.name: On the Spot
